findings.evidence: mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Module/Submodule/LinearMap.lean:344 `def inclusion (h : p ≤ p') : p →ₗ[R] p' := p.subtype.codRestrict p' fun ⟨_, hx⟩ => h hx`
findings.issue: `toDualSubmodule` is character-for-character the body of Mathlib's `Submodule.inclusion`: `p.subtype.codRestrict p' fun ⟨_, hx⟩ => h hx`. `Submodule.inclusion L.le_dual` has exactly the stated type.

findings.fix: Delete it; use `Submodule.inclusion_injective L.le_dual` at any future call site.
findings.issue: `toDualSubmodule_injective` re-proves `Submodule.inclusion_injective` by hand (four lines of `Subtype.ext`/`congr_arg`), and has no consumer in the repo.

findings.evidence: mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Module/Submodule/LinearMap.lean:347-349 `@[simp] theorem coe_inclusion (h : p ≤ p') (x : p) : (inclusion h x : M) = x := rfl`
findings.issue: `coe_toDualSubmodule` restates `Submodule.coe_inclusion` (also a `@[simp]` `rfl` lemma) for the same map.

findings.evidence: mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Module/Lattice.lean:179-180 `lemma rank' [IsFractionRing R K] (M : Submodule R V) [IsLattice K M] : Module.rank R M = Module.rank K V`; the PR body is literally `Submodule.IsLattice.rank' ℚ L.carrier`.
findings.issue: `rank_carrier` is a rename of `Submodule.IsLattice.rank'` with the instance filled in — the statement is not simplified or reassociated in any way.

findings.evidence: Line 121-124: `integralForm_cast : (L.integralForm x y : ℚ) = L.form x y`.
findings.fix: Delete it; if a bare existential is wanted, it is `⟨L.integralForm x y, L.integralForm_cast x y⟩`.
findings.issue: `exists_int_eq_form` is a weaker existential restatement of `integralForm_cast`, three lines above it, which already exhibits the integer witness.

findings.evidence: `Submodule.span_le : span R s ≤ p ↔ s ⊆ ↑p` is already used one line earlier for the outer span; `LinearMap.BilinForm.dualSubmodule` (mathlib/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/BilinearForm/DualLattice.lean:37-44) proves the same closure facts by exactly this comap-style argument.
findings.fix: Replace the induction with `Submodule.span_le.mpr` into `Submodule.comap ((B x).restrictScalars ℤ) (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ)`, leaving only the `rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩; exact hint i j` case.
findings.issue: The `Submodule.span_induction` in `ofBasis.le_dual` re-derives, in its `zero`/`add`/`smul` cases, that `{y | B x y ∈ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ)}` is a submodule — that is `Submodule.comap ((B x).restrictScalars ℤ) 1`, and `Submodule.span_le` then discharges the goal from the generators alone.

findings.evidence: `grep -rn "toDualSubmodule\|integralForm\|IntegralLattice" TauCeti/` outside the new file returns nothing — the coercion layer has zero consumers.
findings.fix: Drop the `CoeFun` instance and `coeFun_apply`; use `L.form x y` throughout.
findings.issue: The `CoeFun` instance plus `@[simp] coeFun_apply : L x y = L.form x y` create a second spelling of `L.form` that the simp lemma immediately rewrites back; no declaration in the PR or the repo uses it. `Membership`/`mem_carrier` (line 79) is the same shape for `L.carrier`.

summary: The structure and its constructors are new, but `toDualSubmodule` and its two lemmas re-implement `Submodule.inclusion`/`coe_inclusion`/`inclusion_injective` verbatim, and `rank_carrier` is a pure alias of `Submodule.IsLattice.rank'`. Several smaller re-derivations (span_induction closure, `exists_int_eq_form`, the `CoeFun` layer) should also go.
